loss: Unweighted mean absolute error on identical genuine shadow origin/target/context pairs in the current telemetry era
unavailable_incumbent: Persistence fallback or abstention; no unsupported emergency expert switch
reset_selection: Reset incumbent to default ARIMA and restart dwell at the era boundary; label as telemetry default reset, not loss-based switch
insufficient_support: Hold the current incumbent; no loss-based switch
ties: Retain incumbent within tolerance; fixed expert order is the secondary deterministic ordering
accounting: Shadow errors, matched selector support, actual adaptive-policy errors, persistence errors and unissued attempts remain separate
